quote_zh: 将2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯、溶剂、催化剂、氢溴酸加入反应瓶，在80℃以下滴加双氧水，滴加完毕后继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后分层，有机层水洗，浓缩，加溶剂进行重结晶，过滤得2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯；
arithmetic_check: Nothing to close. Claim 1 is a process claim and states no charge, no mass, no volume, no time and no yield for this step. Claim 2 (line 61) states only the molar ratio 2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯 : 催化剂 : 氢溴酸 : 双氧水 = 1:0.01～0.1:1～2:1～2, a ratio with no absolute quantity, so no mass balance and no molar-mass check can be computed. The ratio is internally consistent: four species are named and four ratio terms are printed. Open point for A5: claim 3 (line 63) allows 间氯过氧苯甲酸 as the 催化剂, which the claim 2 ratio then charges at 0.01～0.1 relative to the substrate, an initiator loading rather than the stoichiometric oxidant loading that reagent normally takes; recorded as printed. The temperature bounds 45～80℃ from claim 3 sit inside claim 1's 80℃以下 ceiling and do not conflict with it.

arithmetic_check: Nothing to close. No charge, no mass, no volume, no time and no yield are stated for either the etherification or the 碱解. Claim 5 (line 67) states only the molar ratio 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯 : 碱1 : 催化剂 : 2,2,2-三氟乙醇 : 碱2 = 1:1～2:0.01～0.1:1～2:1～2, a ratio with no absolute quantity; five species are named and five ratio terms are printed, so it is internally consistent. Open point for A5: claim 7 (line 71) gives 反应温度为0～80℃ for 步骤2) without saying whether it governs the etherification, the alkaline hydrolysis, or both, while claim 1 gives 在80℃以下 separately to each; the range was recorded once, on the single conditions object, and the ambiguity left unresolved. quote_zh: 将2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸、催化剂、氯化亚砜、溶剂加入反应瓶，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂；将1,3-环己二酮、溶剂加入反应瓶，在30℃以下滴加三乙胺，LC跟踪至反应完全；反应完全后，加入丙酮氰醇，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加溶剂进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得米黄色固体环磺酮。
arithmetic_check: Nothing to close. No charge, no mass, no volume, no time and no yield are stated for any of the three transformations, and the only physical datum is 米黄色固体. Claim 8 (line 73) states only the molar ratio 2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸 : 催化剂 : 氯化亚砜 : 1,3-环己二酮 : 三乙胺 : 丙酮氰醇 = 1:0.01～0.1:1～2:1～2:2～3:0.01～0.1, a ratio with no absolute quantity; six species are named and six ratio terms are printed, so it is internally consistent. The loadings are chemically coherent with the roles assigned: the diketone at 1～2 and the triethylamine at 2～3 are stoichiometric, while the 催化剂 and the 丙酮氰醇 at 0.01～0.1 are catalytic. Open point for A5: the claim never recites the acid chloride being combined with the 1,3-环己二酮, so the acylation's charge is not fixed by the text; and no claim names the reaction solvent for this step, claim 10 (line 77) naming only the crystallisation solvent, so no solvent volume or class can be checked.
